import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # body_mass_g is text with commas (e.g. '3,900'); convert to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # drop out-of-range body mass (e.g. 3625000, max allowed 6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    # sex has missing values meaning unknown; do not guess -> drop
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = {}
    for sex, group in df.groupby('sex'):
        result[sex] = group['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return result
